svg.text: GENERAL ARRANGEMENT — refer to any length by its tag
Front and side elevation. Every length carries a tag — V up, H across, D into the room — and the table says what sets each one.
FRONT ELEVATION — the mount, with the plate's holes
holes: VESA green, strut bolts red, vents open
THE SAME FOUR, LOOKED AT FROM THE FRONT
all four share the same 260 x 134 rear box and VESA 100 — so the mount does not change
SIDE ELEVATION, WITH ALL FOUR DISPLAYS OVERLAID — depth exaggerated 2.6x
tallest option clears the fridge top by 97 mm
THE REGISTER — every tag, its value, and what sets it
top of the upper strut piece, above the floor
upper piece stands proud of the case top
DERIVED to land a slot on V4
fridge case height — the top clamp bolts here
upper piece lower end, above the floor
GAP — the open window at the box's edge
a real slot on the upper grid
a real slot on the lower grid
rear box, long axis (vertical in portrait)
underside of the case, above the floor
rear box, short axis (horizontal in portrait)
fridge panel to the strut's back face
screen face off the fridge panel
clamp bar long leg, onto the fridge top
clamp bar short leg, down the side
clamp bar held off the hinge cover
